messages:
Simone R: @eng-security heads-up: during a cross-region KMS housekeeping job a developer snapshot inadvertently included several encrypted secret blobs that were later decrypted locally. No public access seen, but some CI creds and a couple of deploy tokens were in the blobs. We need immediate rotations and a brief mitigation window.

Simone R: TL;DR: rotate impacted credentials, revoke old deploy tokens, apply temporary network egress restrictions to the snapshot bucket, and confirm in-thread by EOD. Security has compiled the owner list and DM'd folks.

secbot: Automated detector found 6 potential secret patterns in gs://redwood-snapshots/housekeeping/2026-03-23. Ticket SEC-7708 created and owners notified. No external GET requests logged.

Aisha T: Which services? Is Redwood Dedicated affected?

Simone R: Affected services: ci-runner, repo-syncer, and model-ingest-sandbox. Dedicated customer pools are not in the list. ci-runner used a long-lived token that should be rotated immediately.

Carlos M: Quick action plan for owners: 1) rotate tokens/keys 2) update Vault/secret manager entries 3) restart affected runners/services 4) attach proof (vault read or log output) to SEC-7708. If you need help ping @security-oncall.

ci-eng: Small helper script to rotate GitHub tokens and update Vault (example):
```
NEW_TOKEN=$(gh auth refresh -h github.com --scopes repo,workflow --json token -q .token)
vault kv put secret/ci/runner token=$NEW_TOKEN
# restart runner
docker restart ci-runner || systemctl restart runner
```

platform-ops: We applied a temporary bucket IAM change to deny all reads except from the housekeeping service account and blocked external egress for the bucket origin. We'll leave this in place until rotations are confirmed.

security-oncall: Checklist: 1) rotate tokens/keys 2) revoke old tokens and add them to denylist 3) update CI and deployment configs 4) run `secret-scan --path=gs://redwood-snapshots/housekeeping/` and attach report 5) confirm remediation with timestamped evidence. If rotation cannot be completed immediately, disable the tokens and enforce short TTLs.

Simone R: Note: to avoid noise please confirm in-thread only when your team is done; DM evidence to the sec team if it contains sensitive output. We'll compile a 1-paragraph advisory once all confirmations are in.

Carlos M: I've rotated ci-runner token, updated Vault at secret/ci/runner, and restarted the runner. Test jobs passed. Evidence uploaded to SEC-7708.

Aisha T: Rotated repo-syncer deploy key and removed the old key from repo settings. Added a Vault policy to require dynamic keys for syncer jobs.

platform-ops: model-ingest-sandbox tokens rotated and old tokens denylisted. Bucket egress restrictions remain for 2 hours for monitoring. No customer impact.

secbot: SEC-7708 updated with rotation timestamps and attached reports. Automated alert will remain open until all owners confirm in-thread.

Simone R: Thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) we'll propose a policy to ban long-lived tokens in snapshots and require KMS-wrapped secrets + ephemeral credentials for automation by Q3 2) add sanitizer step to snapshot pipeline to strip secrets before snapshots are archived.

security-oncall: Closing note: if anyone finds other archived snapshots with secrets, open a new SEC ticket and tag this thread. For help migrating to ephemeral credentials, see https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets/ephemeral or ping @security-oncall.
